up: Retrieve all activity records from the assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1614052'. For each record, provide the compound ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), the standard activity type (standard_type), the exact measured value (standard_value), units (standard_units), and the standard relation (standard_relation). Only include rows where standard_relation is '=' (exact values) and standard_value is not null. Order the results by compound identifier and activity type.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614052' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, a.standard_type;
